final: WITH c AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating) SELECT film_id, rating, copies, copies - AVG(copies) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS diff_rating_avg, copies - AVG(copies) OVER () AS diff_overall_avg FROM c ORDER BY diff_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
